name: AddOnChipTotal
job: Selectable add-on chips that fly into a tidy summary tray when chosen, building a running list and total the visitor can take to the booking link
visitor_action: click/tap chips to add or remove; Enter on the summary opens the link
mobile: chips wrap, tray docks under them
motion: chip duplicate arcs into the tray on a spring with a lifting shadow, row lands with a tint flash, count badge pops, total digits roll (reduced-motion: chip state changes, tray updates instantly)
art_direction: Pastry counter: pistachio and cream palette, raspberry active chips, soft rounded cards (UI kept flat and contemporary; gloss dropped per brief)
